lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-grid pattern; spot diameter decreases and spatial density increases significantly towards the anterior cephalic region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity forming primary lattice nodes at intersections with the largest circular centroids on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow luminance gradient across its vertical axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes (commensal remoras) is visible attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
